identity.title: Reconcile Birthday continuity binding across capability and cognitive authorities

values.task_boundary: Reconcile only the contradictory continuity binding and prove composition and fail-closed substitution; do not redesign Runtime or absorb WP-18.
deliverables: One shared verified continuity contract for downstream capability/cognition
Exact review and required CI proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Capability and cognitive validation bind the same verified BirthdayContinuityRecord.
AC-2: Real signed identity, continuity, capability, and governed cognition compose successfully.
AC-3: Substituted record, head, identity root, and identity-record digest each fail with typed rejection.
AC-4: Existing invalid-authority and privacy negatives remain green.
AC-5: No public trust constructor or caller-nominated authority input is added.
AC-6: Fresh exact-head independent review and the one required CI lane pass before merge.
dependencies: Existing Birthday identity and continuity authority contracts
Existing capability and cognitive authority contracts
non_goals: Runtime server, transport, storage, or scheduler redesign
Fixture or cached packet positive proof
